phases.canonical_effect: No write by this attempt; other writers or outsiders may still have changed SS.
phases.action: Record failure/current hash; keep original/desired/intent/temp; do not rerun automatically.

phases.where: os.replace raises or process terminates around replace
phases.canonical_effect: Determine from actual readback, never infer unchanged solely from exception.
phases.action: Record observed current hash if readable; UNKNOWN if not. No automatic rollback.

phases.where: READBACK_HASH / row checks / derive / dependency recheck fails after replacement
phases.canonical_effect: SS may already equal desired, or may have foreign bytes; applied state is distinct from accepted state.
phases.action: Keep actual SS, archive/intent/results and failure. Do not call W04 recover or write original over SS.

phases.where: completion receipt fails after actual derive succeeds
phases.canonical_effect: SS and derive observation remain real but durable closure is incomplete.
phases.action: Keep actual results; report incomplete closure and secondary persistence error, no manufactured completed marker.

recovery_rule: Only a separately authorized explicit Root recovery with current own-write full-hash CAS can change state later. Never autoRollback.

source_evidence_lines.claim: original W04 main has no silent postcommit rollback
